action.command:
for p in \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/deflate.js" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/pako.esm.js" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/lerc.js" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/AboutModule.js" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/DrawModule.js" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/three.core.js" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/vuetify.js" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/js/bootstrap-icons.woff2" \
  "/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/locales/de/common.json" \
  "/examples/Basic/resources/img/mp_logo.png" ; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost$p"); size=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{size_download}" "http://localhost$p"); echo "$code  ${size}B  $p";
done; echo; echo "=== css size served vs disk ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "served: %{size_download}B\n" http://localhost/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/css/masterportal.css; stat -c "disk:   %sB" /var/www/html/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/css/masterportal.css; echo; echo "=== img/tools/draw svgs ==="; ls /var/www/html/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/img/ /var/www/html/examples/mastercode/3_27_1/img/tools/draw/ | head -25; echo; echo "=== apache2ctl -S (vhosts) ==="; apache2ctl -S 2>&1 | head -10
